Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Look: Colour scheme of the built-in demo source only (used when in1 is unconnected). original: default colours. mono: black and bone-white. A connected input is not recoloured.
Accent: 0-1. Tints one object of the demo source red when Look is mono. No effect on a connected input.
Amount: Global multiplier for all glitch effects. 0 = clean image.
Seed: Random seed. Change it for a different glitch sequence.
Rate: Glitch beats per second; blocks, tears and sorts re-roll on each beat.
Rgbsplit: Chromatic channel split along a random direction per beat.
Blockdisplace: Strength of random blocks shifted sideways.
Scanlinetear: Strength of per-row horizontal tearing and the rolling tear band.
Pixelsort: Strength of the streaky pixel-sort approximation.
Smear: Strength of the compression-style smear, where unchanged blocks keep the previous frame.
Sortthreshold: Brightness above which pixels join sort streaks. Lower = more streaks.
Sortaxis: Direction of the sort streaks. horizontal or vertical.
Smearthreshold: How much a block may change before it stops being held. Higher = more frozen blocks.
Active: On: the glitch feedback runs. Off: freezes the feedback.
Reset: Pulse: reload the feedback from the current input.
